Use continuous motion and direction through intermediate frames to assign endpoints; never reset identities at a resting layout or infer them from nearest original positions or detection-list order. Estimate the pair's midpoint across successive frames and follow each identity's displacement around it. Assign the two settling endpoints jointly by continuing their observed rotational branches; do not assign an endpoint by proximity to that identity's starting position or by extrapolating only its last straight-line displacement. Keep every identity outside that moving pair at its committed position.
